component.name: Package Tracker
component.summary: See, update, install and remove packages and check them for telemetry

description.p: A fast, native app that shows everything installed on your system across package managers: APT, RPM (dnf/zypper), pacman, Flatpak, Snap and AppImages.

ul.li: Uninstall with a preview of what else would be removed, and a verdict on whether it is safe
Update single packages, a selection, or everything with one password prompt
See what uses a package, including running processes
Search and install new software from every source at once
Find apps installed twice, unused dependencies and leftover data
Spot known telemetry and turn it off
Watch live network connections per program
Manage login apps and services, repositories and install history

screenshot.caption: Every package from every source, with removal verdicts and telemetry
Telemetry findings: uninstall or turn off
One search across every source, with what installing pulls in

ul.li: System scan on the Suggestions tab: unfinished installs, drivers that don't build for a new kernel, failed services, low disk space, pending restart, with one-click fixes
Cleanup of leftover kernel folders and of menu entries for deleted AppImages
Uninstalling an AppImage removes every menu entry, also those made by other tools
Bulk updates no longer fail when a snap is open; driver build failures are explained
A short notice on first launch about using the app at your own risk
Tick several packages and update them together
.rpm package for Fedora, RHEL and openSUSE
